answer: When an AI‑agent network hashes each node’s public key into an opal‑colored ledger slot, it also groups slots into karst‑shaped clusters by similarity of cryptographic proofs; each cluster receives a fixed falcon‑scaled reward pool that cannot exceed the total pledged stake.
